from pathlib import Path

path = Path("src/aspenops_nexus/pool.py")
text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

single_start = text.index("    def _evaluate_singleflight(\n")
single_end = text.index("    def evaluate_many(\n", single_start)
single = text[single_start:single_end]
old_parse = "                result = EvaluationResult.from_dict(deepcopy(cached))"
if single.count(old_parse) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError("Singleflight cached-result parse target changed")
single = single.replace(
    old_parse,
    "                result = EvaluationResult.from_dict(cached)",
    1,
)
text = text[:single_start] + single + text[single_end:]

batch_start = text.index("    def _evaluate_many_locked(\n")
batch = text[batch_start:]
old_cache_block = "\n".join(
    [
        "        output: list[EvaluationResult | None] = [None] * len(requests)",
        "        unique: dict[str, tuple[EvaluationRequest, list[int]]] = {}",
        "        for index, (key, request) in enumerate(keyed_requests):",
        "            cached = cached_payloads.get(key) if request.reinitialize else None",
        "            if cached is not None:",
        "                result = EvaluationResult.from_dict(deepcopy(cached))",
        '                result.cache_source = "persistent_cache"',
        "                result.cache_hit = True",
        "                result.request_hash = key",
        "                output[index] = result",
        "                continue",
        "            unique.setdefault(key, (request, []))[1].append(index)",
    ]
)
new_cache_block = "\n".join(
    [
        "        output: list[EvaluationResult | None] = [None] * len(requests)",
        "        unique: dict[str, tuple[EvaluationRequest, list[int]]] = {}",
        "        cached_results: dict[str, EvaluationResult] = {}",
        "        for index, (key, request) in enumerate(keyed_requests):",
        "            cached = cached_payloads.get(key) if request.reinitialize else None",
        "            if cached is not None:",
        "                template = cached_results.get(key)",
        "                if template is None:",
        "                    result = EvaluationResult.from_dict(cached)",
        '                    result.cache_source = "persistent_cache"',
        "                    result.cache_hit = True",
        "                    result.request_hash = key",
        "                    cached_results[key] = result",
        "                else:",
        "                    result = deepcopy(template)",
        "                output[index] = result",
        "                continue",
        "            unique.setdefault(key, (request, []))[1].append(index)",
    ]
)
if batch.count(old_cache_block) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError("Batch cached-result block target changed")
batch = batch.replace(old_cache_block, new_cache_block, 1)
old_return = "return [replace(item) for item in output if item is not None]"
if batch.count(old_return) != 2:
    raise RuntimeError("Expected two redundant final shallow-copy returns")
batch = batch.replace(old_return, "return [item for item in output if item is not None]")
text = text[:batch_start] + batch
path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
